subject: MSA v2.5 — Final Agreed Terms Confirmation
body:
Dear Jessica,

We are pleased to confirm that VendorX Solutions Ltd. agrees to the terms set out in MSA v2.5 (Final), dated 2026-01-29.

Key agreed terms:
1. Liability cap: 12 months of fees paid (per TechCo's position)
2. IP indemnification: four options including procure rights
3. Force majeure notice: 10 days
4. All other terms as per v2.5

We will proceed to execution. Please arrange for signature by your authorised signatory.

Kind regards,
Markus Braun
General Counsel, VendorX Solutions Ltd.
